description: Invite a new person into a portal: creates their account and mails the portal's invitation letter. The new account gets a password of its own, which only the invitation letter shows (with a one-time link that signs the person in); the answer's `invitation` says what was mailed. Never tell anyone a password.

send_email.description: Mail the portal's invitation letter (default true). false: nobody is told a password — the person sets their own from the portal's sign-in page.

name: invite_portal_user
